source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of descriptive statistics (PDF 128-129).

blocks.text: Descriptive statistics data ka khulasa aur tarteeb karti hain ta ke har qeemat ki bajaye poori tasveer nazar aaye. Das students ke scores 50, 65, 75, 80, 85, 90, 95, 60, 70 aur 88 hain. In ka mean (50 + 65 + 75 + 80 + 85 + 90 + 95 + 60 + 70 + 88) / 10 = 758 / 10 = 75.8; sab se zyada 95 aur sab se kam 50.

blocks.prompt: Data ko tasveeri shakal dena descriptive statistics samajhne mein kaise madad deta hai (short question 4)?
blocks.explanation: Chart ek nazar mein dikhata hai jo adad khulasa karte hain: histogram dikhata hai ke zyada qeematein kahan hain aur kitni phaili hain, boxplot median, quartiles aur bahar wali qeematein dikhata, aur bar ya line chart ausat ka muwazna ya rujhan dikhata hai. Andaaz, ghair maamooli qeematein aur groups ke farq har adad parhe baghair wazeh ho jate hain.

items: Descriptive statistics data ka khulasa karti hain: das scores ka mean 75.8, sab se zyada 95, sab se kam 50.
